# Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Node.js TypeScript Application

## Project Structure
```
project/
├── Dockerfile
├── .dockerignore
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── src/
    └── index.ts
```

## Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# ============================================================
# Stage 1: Dependencies
# Install ALL dependencies (including devDependencies)
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS dependencies

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy package files first to leverage Docker layer caching
# Only reinstalls when package files change
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install all dependencies including devDependencies needed for build
# --frozen-lockfile ensures reproducible installs
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile

# ============================================================
# Stage 2: Builder
# Compile TypeScript to JavaScript
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app

# Copy installed dependencies from previous stage
COPY --from=dependencies /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# Copy TypeScript config and source files
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/

# Also copy package.json (needed for npm scripts)
COPY package.json ./

# Compile TypeScript → JavaScript
# Output goes to /app/dist (as configured in tsconfig.json)
RUN npm run build

# ============================================================
# Stage 3: Production Dependencies
# Install ONLY production dependencies (no devDependencies)
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS prod-dependencies

WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install only production dependencies
# This creates a clean, minimal node_modules
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile --omit=dev

# ============================================================
# Stage 4: Runner (Final Image)
# Minimal image with only what's needed to run the app
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner

# Install dumb-init for proper signal handling and PID 1 management
# This ensures graceful shutdowns work correctly
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# Create a non-root user for security
# Running as root inside containers is a security risk
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs && \
    adduser --system --uid 1001 --ingroup nodejs appuser

WORKDIR /app

# Copy only production node_modules from prod-dependencies stage
COPY --from=prod-dependencies --chown=appuser:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# Copy compiled JavaScript from builder stage
COPY --from=builder --chown=appuser:nodejs /app/dist ./dist

# Copy package.json (needed for runtime metadata, npm scripts, etc.)
COPY --chown=appuser:nodejs package.json ./

# Switch to non-root user
USER appuser

# Expose application port
EXPOSE 3000

# Set NODE_ENV to production
ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Use dumb-init as entrypoint to handle signals properly
# Then run the compiled app directly with node (not ts-node)
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Supporting Files

### .dockerignore
```dockerignore
# Dependencies (will be installed fresh in container)
node_modules/

# TypeScript source (only compiled output is needed in final image)
# Note: src/ IS needed in builder stage, handled via COPY in Dockerfile
dist/

# Version control
.git/
.gitignore

# Docker files themselves
Dockerfile
.dockerignore

# Environment files (inject via secrets/env vars at runtime)
.env
.env.*
!.env.example

# Logs
logs/
*.log
npm-debug.log*

# OS files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# IDE files
.vscode/
.idea/
*.swp
*.swo

# Test files (not needed in production image)
**/*.test.ts
**/*.spec.ts
**/__tests__/
coverage/

# CI/CD
.github/
.gitlab-ci.yml

# Documentation
README.md
docs/
```

### tsconfig.json
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": false,
    "sourceMap": false,
    "removeComments": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noImplicitReturns": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.spec.ts"]
}
```

### package.json
```json
{
  "name": "my-typescript-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Node.js TypeScript application",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "ts-node src/index.ts",
    "watch": "tsc --watch",
    "lint": "eslint src/**/*.ts",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^20.10.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.0.0"
  }
}
```

### src/index.ts (Example Application)
```typescript
import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT ?? 3000;

app.use(express.json());

app.get('/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json({
    status: 'healthy',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
  });
});

app.get('/', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json({ message: 'Hello from TypeScript!' });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT} in ${process.env.NODE_ENV} mode`);
});

export default app;
```

## Build & Run Commands

```bash
# Build the image
docker build -t my-ts-app:latest .

# Build with specific target stage (useful for debugging)
docker build --target builder -t my-ts-app:debug .

# Run the container
docker run -p 3000:3000 --env-file .env my-ts-app:latest

# Run with environment variables
docker run -p 3000:3000 \
  -e NODE_ENV=production \
  -e PORT=3000 \
  my-ts-app:latest

# Check final image size
docker images my-ts-app

# Inspect image layers
docker history my-ts-app:latest

# Run with docker-compose
docker-compose up --build
```

## Docker Compose (Optional)

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.9'

services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runner          # Build only up to the runner stage
    image: my-ts-app:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3000
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # Development service using the builder stage
  app-dev:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: builder
    volumes:
      - ./src:/app/src      # Mount source for live reloading
    ports:
      - "3001:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=development
    command: ["npm", "run", "watch"]
    profiles:
      - dev
```

## Size Optimization Summary

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Image Size Comparison                     │
├──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┤
│ node:20 (full)           │ ~1.1 GB                          │
│ node:20-slim             │ ~240 MB                          │
│ node:20-alpine           │ ~180 MB                          │
│ Our final image          │ ~85-100 MB (alpine + prod only)  │
├──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┤
│ What's excluded from final image:                           │
│  ✗ TypeScript compiler (tsc)                                │
│  ✗ devDependencies (@types/*, typescript, etc.)             │
│  ✗ Source .ts files                                         │
│  ✗ Build tools and caches                                   │
│  ✗ npm cache                                                │
│                                                             │
│ What's included in final image:                             │
│  ✓ Compiled .js files (dist/)                               │
│  ✓ Production node_modules only                             │
│  ✓ dumb-init (signal handling)                              │
│  ✓ Non-root user (security)                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Key Design Decisions

| Decision | Reason |
|---|---|
| `node:20-alpine` base | Minimal OS footprint (~5MB vs ~180MB for Debian) |
| 4 separate stages | Maximum layer reuse and cache efficiency |
| `npm ci` over `npm install` | Reproducible, faster, respects lockfile |
| Separate prod-deps stage | Clean production `node_modules` without devDeps |
| `dumb-init` as PID 1 | Proper SIGTERM/SIGINT handling for graceful shutdown |
| Non-root user | Security best practice, limits blast radius |
| `--chown` on COPY | Sets correct file ownership without extra `RUN chown` layer |
| `sourceMap: false` in tsconfig | Smaller dist output, no source exposure in production |
